title: Add subtract(a, b) function with unit test
description: Add a subtract(a, b) function to backend/app.py that mirrors the style and conventions of the existing add(a, b) function, and write a unit test for it consistent with any existing test for add(a, b).
acceptance_criteria: backend/app.py contains a subtract(a, b) function that returns a - b
subtract(a, b) follows the same code style/conventions as the existing add(a, b) function
A unit test for subtract(a, b) exists alongside (or matching the style of) the existing test for add(a, b)
The new unit test covers at least one typical case and passes when run
Existing add(a, b) functionality and its test remain unchanged and passing
